requirements.text: The pipeline shall ingest an RDL scene and preserve stable object identities.
The pipeline shall derive room semantics grounded in existing RDL objects.
The pipeline shall synthesize backend-compatible spatial agent roles.
Every generated agent knowledge tag shall be covered by materialized knowledge.
Every generated agent shall be placed inside the room without obstacle overlap.
The generated behavior shall be traceable from requirements to runtime actions and validation cases.

scenarios.description: Authoring pipeline for generating and validating a spatially grounded multi-agent room guide.

steps.text: Provide an RDL file as case-study input.
Load and normalize the RDL scene.
Derive semantic zones, visitor goals and interaction topics.
Generate spatially grounded agent roles and handoff rules.
Generate materialized knowledge entries for all agent knowledge tags.
Place generated agents inside the room near their responsibilities.
Assemble and validate the RoomContract trace instance.
Materialize the Interactive Agents project files.
Set up an Interactive Agents runtime session.
Ask a general room-related question to an agent.
Answer a general visitor question without a selected scene object.
Optionally hand off a general question to a responsible specialist agent.

actors.name: Case Study Engineer
actors.description: Provides RDL input and runs the validation pipeline.

actors.name: Visitor
actors.description: Asks room-related questions in the generated immersive environment.

actors.name: Room Guide
actors.description: Role played by generated interactive agents.

entities.name: Plankton and Depth Zone
entities.purpose: Showcase plankton species and ocean depth stations to educate visitors about microscopic ocean life and depth-related phenomena.

entities.name: Coral and Current Zone
entities.purpose: Display coral models and current diagrams to explain coral reef ecosystems and ocean current dynamics.

entities.name: Submersible and Shell Zone
entities.purpose: Present submersible models and shell cases to illustrate underwater exploration technology and marine biodiversity.

agents.persona: Friendly and enthusiastic guide passionate about microscopic ocean life and depth zones, eager to share fascinating facts and answer visitor questions.
Knowledgeable marine ecologist with a calm and engaging manner, skilled at explaining coral reef dynamics and ocean current patterns to visitors.
Tech-savvy and curious expert fascinated by underwater exploration and marine biodiversity, eager to demonstrate submersible models and shell cases.

events.expression: visitor question belongs to another agent expertise

conditions.expression: at least two valid agents exist
handoff target exists and is not the source agent

stateAssertions.expression: Normalized RDL scene is valid and object IDs are unique.
Scene semantics are grounded in existing object IDs.
Generated agents have valid zones, objects, knowledge tags and handoff targets.
Every agent knowledge tag has at least one materialized knowledge entry.
Every generated agent has a valid room position and forward vector.
RoomContract instance satisfies all core invariants.
Interactive Agents project files are present and backend-readable.
Interactive Agents backend setup returns a valid session with all agents.
A visitor question is answered using room-grounded agent knowledge.
A specialist handoff targets an existing responsible agent when needed.

capabilities.text: Analyze RDL scene structure and normalize room objects.

effects.text: Effect of DERIVE-SPATIAL-AGENT-ROLES: agent roles valid.

capabilities.text: Generate local knowledge entries for all agent knowledge tags.
